verdict.rationale: The clearest first-party bulk capability is the Codex Security plugin's `bulk-scan`, which reviews many repositories in one campaign. Supporting evidence is thinner: commenting on one or more images in Canvas view, running projects in parallel, and delegating independent work to subagents. These show some multi-item and parallel handling, but there is no documented general-purpose way to apply one operation across many items. Missing for 10: a general bulk-operation feature beyond security scanning (e.g., batch edits across many files, chats, or records), detailed docs on bulk limits and behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
